limitations: Four fixed matched cases, each with three stochastic trajectories; plies are correlated observations, not 160 independent samples.
All first comparator/v3 divergences were opponent choices before the first v3 nonbaseline selection. Shared seed/settings do not seed Stockfish limited-strength RNG.
Only one Queen's Gambit prefix, two opponent settings and both colors were covered. No generalization to all openings, human feel or human Elo.
Every segment was capped at44plies with result*. No completed-game win/draw rates or playing-strength/Elo claims.
No arm kept all first40plies within100cp. V3 still had two own-behind-beyond200cp postmove positions, compared with before0 and v1 16.
The three/four/one large imbalance increases were all opponent moves creating AI advantage, not a measured count of Regicide blunders.
V3 selects among native Regicide candidates using external Stockfish evidence: externally assisted practice, not standalone Regicide strength.

The offline judge was a separate fixed-depth14 Stockfish18 process; same-parent diagnosis used depth16. These depths are not always deeper than live screening and are not an independent engine-family oracle.
Same clocks and opponent resources do not imply equal total CPU. V3 adds native discovery and Stockfish screening; desktop load samples are not per-process CPU isolation.
Own turn wall time averages include plies5..44 after the fixed prefix and differ across resulting positions; no efficiency-improvement claim.
